item.title: Inland Fisheries Ireland issue appeal over damage at Drum Lough
item.description: Inland Fisheries Ireland are seeking the public's assistance after a fishing platform used by wheelchair users was partially burned down. The incident occurred on Sunday last at Drum Lough. The damage was highlighted earlier this week by local councillor Richard Truell. The fishing podium was set alight between Sunday night and early Monday morning. The IFI asks anyone with information to call Monaghan Garda station on 047 77200. Advertisement

item.title: Local counties see 8.1 per cent growth in property prices
item.description: Counties in the border region, including Cavan and Monaghan saw an 8.1% growth in property prices in the year to December 2025. That's according to figures released by the Central Statistics Office this week. The regions outside of Dublin that saw the largest growth in house prices were the Midlands (Laois, Longford, Offaly, and Westmeath) at 14.4%. item.title: Cavan senator contests retirement age for school bus drivers
item.description: A Cavan senator recently raised the issue of school bus driver's retirement age in the Seanad. Pauline Tully was speaking as a bus operator in Cavan is set to lose three drivers this year for school runs. This is due to the Bus Eireann rule that someone cannot drive a bus once they reach 70 years of age. item.title: Cavan councillor calls for support on e-scooter regulations
item.description: A Cavan County Councillor has called for the local authority to support regulation of scrambler bikes and e scooters. Shane P O'Reilly raised the issue at the recent full meeting of Cavan County Council. He asked for the council to fully support the government's plan to ban scrambler bikes and regulate e-scooters. Cllr O'Reilly said we have a major problem with e-scooters, and that the laws are being flouted. Speaking to Northern Sound, he outlined his concerns with the e-scooters. Advertisement

item.title: Cavan win while Monaghan lose in hurling league
item.description: Cavan landed their first win of the Allianz league division four with a five point win over Lancashire. Two first-half goals from Mark Moffett set Cavan up for victory as the Breffni side led 2-14 to nine points at half time. item.title: Today marks 38 years since the murder of Aidan McAnespie
item.description: Today marks 38 years since Aidan McAnespie was shot on his way to a Gaelic football match in Co Tyrone. Mr McAnespie was shot dead close to a checkpoint near Aughnacloy on the Monaghan-Tyrone border as he walked to a GAA match. The 23-year-old was on his way to a GAA match when the fatal bullet ricocheted off the road and struck him in the back before exiting via the front of his chest. He died at the scene.
